name: HAEMATOXYLON CAMPECHIANUM
key_symptoms: Painful digging from abdomen to throat, causing pain in region of heart with oppression. Colic, tympanitis. Borborygmi and diarrhœa. Swollen, painful.
Constriction, extending to epigastrium. Sensation of a bar across chest. Convulsive pain in heart region with oppression. Great soreness in region of heart. Palpitation.
Feels constricted; heavy, hot. Eyelids heavy.
